name: v2-callback-refactor
prompt: Refactor this project's order API: rename the export getUserOrders to fetchCustomerOrders and convert it from error-first callback style to a Promise-based async function that rejects on errors. Update every call site (handlers, report, cli) to the new API and remove the old callback export entirely. test.js is the acceptance spec: do not modify it. Make the verification pass and summarize the migration.
verify:
python3 -c "import hashlib,sys
if hashlib.sha256(open('test.js','rb').read()).hexdigest()!='99ca47ae9d44ec19de4aa9d6d5a4147fc1878005d9644a05b8a0157d62e550a3': sys.exit('protected file changed: test.js')"

node -e "const fs=require('fs');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(d+'/'+e.name):[d+'/'+e.name]);const bad=walk('src').filter(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').includes('getUserOrders'));if(bad.length){console.error('old API still referenced in: '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
